column3: internal/service/cancellations.go validate and the service_cancellations CHECK accept immediate and end_of_period, but web/src/views/portal-service.ts posts only the end-of-period /api/v1/portal/services/{id}/cancel route, so no customer screen offers an immediate request.

service.MaxReasonLength and the service_cancellations reason CHECK bound the text at 255 characters and web/src/views/cancellations.ts renders it, but the portal cancel path portal.Manager.RequestCancellation accepts no reason, so a customer cannot supply one.

service_cancellations, service.Store.Cancellations and GET /api/v1/staff/cancellations back web/src/views/cancellations.ts, but portal.Manager.RequestCancellation only sets subscriptions.cancel_at_period_end and inserts no row, so a portal cancellation never reaches the queue.

notify.EventServiceCancellationReceived and its CancellationReceived template mail the customer from notifyCancellationReceived in internal/httpapi/service_cancellations.go, but no staff notification is emitted and the legacy portal cancel path sends nothing.
internal/renewal/renewal.go returns OutcomeSkippedCancelled and calls endSubscription when subscriptions.cancel_at_period_end is set, so no further period is invoiced.

service.Store.ExecuteCancellation enqueues the terminate operation through enqueueOperation with the terminate:<service>:<generation> key and web/src/views/cancellations.ts exposes it as Execute, although the scheduled ExecuteDue job is not wired into cmd/billing/jobs.go.

portal.actionsFor offers cancel only for an active service whose cancel_at_period_end is false, and service.Store.requestCancellation accepts only active or suspended statuses and refuses a second open request, so the action list and the handler agree.

product_upgrades in internal/store/migrations/0020_commerce.sql plus internal/httpapi/upgrades_ext.go and web/src/views/upgrades.ts provide the directed graph with admin add and remove, and internal/service/upgrades.go reachable enforces it.

web/src/views/portal-service.ts requests an upgrade from /api/v1/portal/services/{id}/upgrade-options and the store enforces the same interval and currency, but config options are changed through a separate PUT /api/v1/portal/services/{id}/config call rather than as part of the upgrade.

service.ComputeProration and ProratedDifference in internal/service/upgrades.go prorate by the exact remaining fraction of the real billing period with one RoundHalfUp rounding, and prorationJSON in internal/httpapi/service_upgrades.go exposes the ratio.

an upgrade issues a prorated invoice via issueProratedInvoice, but a downgrade only records CreditMinor with CreditPending in service.Store.upgrade and nothing in internal/credit calls ApplyDowngrade, so the credit is never posted.

service.Store.ApplyUpgrade reprices the subscription and enqueues a resize operation, but ApplyPendingUpgrades is not scheduled in cmd/billing/jobs.go and no route calls it, so a paid upgrade is never applied automatically.
service.Store.CancelStaleUpgrades voids an unpaid upgrade invoice after StaleUpgradeAfter, but cmd/billing/jobs.go registers no job for it, which docs/parity-status.md E2.2 also records.

config_options in internal/store/migrations/0020_commerce.sql carries parent_id, option_type of dropdown/radio/checkbox/text/number, env_variable, hidden, upgradable, sort_order and description, edited by web/src/views/config-options.ts.
config_option_prices keys amount_minor and setup_minor by config_option_id, price_version_id and choice, and web/src/views/config-options.ts edits that matrix per price version.
config_options.product_id attaches every option to a product and service.Store.ConfigOptions reads them per product, a single-owner column rather than Paymenter's config_option_products join.

internal/register/checkout.go and internal/customer/service.go write the selection to service_configs and ResolveSelection builds the env map, but provisioning.Worker Operation.metadata sends only service_id, customer_id, server_id and server_node, so env_variable values never reach the adapter.

service.Store.ChangeServiceConfig re-prices an upgradable option through the same proration and service_upgrades row and PUT /api/v1/portal/services/{id}/config is offered by web/src/views/portal-service.ts.
internal/extproto/spec.go has no method for an extension to supply checkout fields and checkout options come only from config_options via loadConfig in internal/register/checkout.go.
the staff routes in internal/httpapi/service_config.go create, update, delete and price options, rendered by web/src/views/config-options.ts.

config_options.upgradable is edited by the Upgradable switch in web/src/views/config-options.ts and enforced by ChangeServiceConfig and handlePortalConfigOptions in internal/httpapi/portal_services.go.

tickets, ticket_messages, ticket_attachments and ticket_mail_logs exist in internal/store/migrations/0020_commerce.sql and every route in internal/httpapi/tickets.go is gated on ticket:read:self, ticket:write:self, ticket:read:all or ticket:write:all.
ticket_messages stores author_user_id, from_staff, body and message_id, read by Store.threadTx and written by insertMessage in internal/tickets/tickets.go.

tickets.ValidateAttachment, AddAttachmentAsCustomer and AddAttachmentAsStaff in internal/tickets/attachments.go enforce MaxAttachmentBytes of 10 MB and a content-type allowlist, and writeAttachment sets nosniff and an attachment Content-Disposition on download.

POST /api/v1/portal/tickets with subject, department, priority, service_id and a first message runs Store.CreateTx, which also stores custom-field answers and refuses the create naming an unanswered required field.
Store.ListForCustomer filters on customer_id and status with cursor pagination, is served by handlePortalTickets and rendered in web/src/views/tickets.ts.
Store.ThreadForCustomer, ReplyAsCustomerTx and CloseAsCustomerTx back web/src/views/ticket.ts, and requireCloseAnswers refuses a close with the unanswered field's label.

Store.ListForStaff filters by status, priority, department, assignee and query, and internal/httpapi/tickets_staff.go adds reply, close, assign, patch and staff create for a named customer_id, rendered by web/src/views/support-queue.ts and web/src/views/support.ts.
the tickets settings group in internal/settings/settings.go holds departments, priorities are tickets.Priorities, statuses are tickets.Statuses, and defaults come from tickets.DefaultSettings.
tickets.disabled and tickets.client_closing_disabled are read by settingsFrom and enforced as ErrDisabled and ErrClosingDisabled, edited in web/src/views/system-settings.ts.
tickets.CloseStale closes stale tickets after tickets.autoclose_days and the ticket-autoclose job in cmd/billing/jobs.go runs it every six hours.

the webhook POST /api/v1/webhooks/mail/piping and the hand-written IMAP poller in internal/tickets/imap.go share Ingest with message-id threading and ticket_mail_logs, but inbound attachments are counted and refused rather than imported.
ticket_mail_logs in internal/store/migrations/0020_commerce.sql stores message_id, subject, from_address, to_address, body and status, written by Store.logInbound and listed by ListInboundMail.

notify.EventNewTicketMessage has mail and in-app templates, but notify.TicketMessage is called only from notifyAssignee in internal/tickets/piping.go, so a staff reply in tickets_staff.go notifies no customer and a portal reply notifies no assignee.

customers reach tickets from web/src/ui/layout.ts and web/src/views/tickets.ts, but web/src/views/portal.ts has no ticket card, so the only dashboard widget is the staff open_tickets one in internal/httpapi/dashboard_widgets.go.
internal/extproto/events.go lists ticket.created, ticket.replied, ticket.closed, ticket.assigned and ticket.updated and internal/httpapi/extension_hooks.go delivers them to subscribed extensions.
